errors.evidence: The term "显著" (significant) is a subjective interpretation of the magnitude of the increase. While the increase from layer 1 to 2 is the largest, describing it as "significant" is an evaluative judgment not explicitly stated in the chart data.

The term "最优" (optimal) is an evaluative conclusion. The chart shows that 2 layers have the highest F1 value, but calling it "optimal" is an interpretation of performance that goes beyond simply stating it is the maximum value shown.
